Class GraphDslDriver

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.lcarsgraph.GraphDslDriver
public final class GraphDslDriver extends Object
One empty graph hydrates from the conversation. A graph that already holds an intent is left as the vault restored it. The ask is the EN-IR brief. One repair follows a fault.

  • Method Details

    • importEmpty

      public static int importEmpty(GraphModel model, List<GraphTurn> turns, GraphDoor door, GraphDslDriver.Land land) throws Exception
      The method fills an empty model from the turns. A model that already holds an aim returns zero and does not ask. A model whose every intent is the map phrase is not a kept map. That model is cleared and asked. A missing door, a missing model, or an empty turn list returns zero. Each passing step is applied before the next ask. A second fault leaves that step off the model.
      Parameters:
      model - The model receives a passing block.
      turns - The turns are the conversation, oldest first.
      door - The door sends one brief.
      land - The land stores one passing step. A null land only fills the model.
      Returns:
      The return value is the number of steps applied.
      Throws:
      Exception - The exception is a door that does not send.

    • grow

      public static int grow(GraphModel model, List<GraphTurn> turns, GraphDoor door, GraphDslDriver.Land land) throws Exception
      The method walks a fresh graph, then each later turn. An empty model births the first turn and folds each later turn. A model that already holds an aim folds only the newest turn. The import walk stays on importEmpty(GraphModel, List, GraphDoor, GraphDslDriver.Land).
      Parameters:
      model - The model receives a passing block.
      turns - The turns are the conversation, oldest first.
      door - The door sends one brief.
      land - The land stores one passing step. A null land only fills the model.
      Returns:
      The return value is the number of steps applied.
      Throws:
      Exception - The exception is a door that does not send.

    • fault

      public static String fault(GraphModel model, List<GraphTurn> known, List<GraphTurn> window, String opening, String reply)
      The method checks one reply. A null return is a passing block.
      Parameters:
      model - The model is the graph already accepted.
      known - The known list is every turn in the conversation.
      window - The window is this step.
      opening - The opening is fresh, import, or turn.
      reply - The reply is the model text.
      Returns:
      The return value is the fault, or null when the block passes.

    • apply

      public static void apply(GraphModel model, List<GraphTurn> known, List<GraphTurn> window, String reply, List<String[]> feeds)
      The method applies a passing block. A cell line does not create an intent. A glue word on a meat line is dropped. A meat word already tethered to another aim links those aims. There is no cap on the meat lines one aim holds.
      Parameters:
      model - The model receives the block.
      known - The known list maps a protocol label to a vault card.
      window - The window is this step.
      reply - The reply is the passing text.
      feeds - The feeds receive card and node pairs.
